text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience helping teams organize, clean, and present data clearly and accurately. I’d be glad to help with your Excel sheet, download and organize the category icons, and make sure everything is imported into WooCommerce in a way that looks good and functions properly.

My background includes SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard work, data cleaning, and data visualization, so I’m comfortable working through structured data and handling detail-heavy tasks carefully. For your project, I would review the supplied Excel file, map each icon link to the correct category, verify the files are usable for upload, and work through the import process with attention to WordPress and WooCommerce requirements. I also understand the importance of making sure the icons display correctly across devices and browsers, and I can troubleshoot issues if anything doesn’t behave as expected.

A few relevant examples of my past work include building a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture, where I created one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports. That work helped consolidate reporting and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. I also built a Dental clinic expansion model for Sunrise Dental Partners, using Excel financial modeling to compare three site options with best, base, and worst cases for patient volume and staffing. That model helped evaluate the selected site’s projected payback in 14 months.

I’m comfortable working independently, communicating clearly, and providing a concise summary of what was completed along with any recommendations for future maintenance. If needed, I can keep the process organized so you have a clear record of what was imported, adjusted, and tested.

Would you like the summary report to be structured as a simple checklist of completed steps, or as a more detailed handoff note for future updates?
